title: Junior React Native Developer
description:
We are looking for passionate and motivated React Native Developers based in Kerala with 6 months to 1 year of experience in mobile application development.

This role is ideal for candidates who are eager to learn, improve their skills, and contribute to building high\-quality mobile applications. You will work closely with experienced developers and cross\-functional teams to develop and maintain mobile applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in developing and maintaining mobile applications using React Native.
* Collaborate with designers, developers, and project managers to implement application features.
* Convert UI/UX designs and wireframes into functional mobile app components.
* Support the development of reusable components and code for efficient development.
* Identify and fix bugs with guidance from senior developers.
* Assist in improving application performance and user experience.
* Participate in code reviews and team discussions to enhance coding practices.
* Help troubleshoot technical issues and support timely issue resolution.
* Perform API testing using Postman or similar tools to verify requests and responses.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of JavaScript and ES6 concepts.
* Hands\-on experience or project experience with React Native.
* Basic knowledge of state management (Redux or Context API).
* Familiarity with REST APIs and asynchronous programming.
* Basic understanding of mobile UI/UX principles.
* Knowledge of Git or version control systems.
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and work effectively in a team environment.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (preferred).

Work Location: In person

title: Associate - Web Development
description:
**About the role**

The Associate \- Web Development will help build and maintain modern, content\-driven web applications. You'll work closely with the founding engineer to deliver production\-ready features, integrate APIs, improve CMS workflows, and build scalable frontend experiences.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Build responsive web pages using Next.js
* Develop reusable UI components using Tailwind CSS
* Translate Figma or Adobe XD designs into pixel\-perfect frontend code
* Integrate Strapi CMS with frontend applications
* Build and consume REST/GraphQL APIs
* Work with PostgreSQL databases
* Implement authentication and business workflows
* Collaborate on Make.com and n8n automations
* Debug production issues and optimize performance
* Participate in code reviews and Git\-based development
* Deploy applications using Docker and CI/CD pipelines \[1, 2]

**Required Technical Skills:**

* 1–2 years of experience in React/Next.js
* JavaScript or TypeScript
* HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS
* Proficiency in extracting assets and specs from Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch
* Strapi or another Headless CMS
* REST API integration
* PostgreSQL
* Git/GitHub
* Basic Docker knowledge \[1]

**Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field

**Good to have:**

* n8n or Make.com automation
* AI API integrations (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini)
* GraphQL
* Vercel or Railway deployments
* AWS basics
* Experience working in startup environments

**What We're Looking For:**

* Comfortable owning features end\-to\-end
* Good UI implementation skills
* Strong debugging ability
* Clear communication
* Willingness to learn quickly and ship fast
* Attention to clean, maintainable code

Application Question(s):

* Are you from Kerala?

Work Location: In person
